object.attr: derived: a client gives up after its own timeout while the write still completes, and the agent then retries a write that happened (CF-M15). Values measured first, set at half the shortest per-call timeout among the clients in use (Q-M8).
object.description: On the reference machine, the MCP server should answer each tool call other than `export_document` and `compare_document` at most TBD s after receiving the call, on a repository of TBD documents of 1,000 objects each.
